title: Festive Rollout Series
description: A reference-driven Lunar New Year campaign system that locks festive energy, gifting structure, and rollout consistency across retail and hospitality surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a celebratory but premium New Year campaign world built from lacquer red, warm gold, floral freshness, and gifting trays; images 02-04 preserve that exact language while moving into beauty retail, dining celebration, and premium bundle variations.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-festive-tray-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-beauty-counter-variation, 03-banquet-table-variation, 04-premium-bundle-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-festive-tray-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
